zh: 半个月以后，陈世龙原船回湖州，没有把畹香带来，但一百两银票却已送了给畹香，因为她也听说王有龄放了湖州府，愿意到湖州来玩一趟，只是要晚些日子。陈世龙急于要回来复命，无法等她，“安家费”反正要送的，落得漂亮些，就先给了她。“做得好！这件事不去管它了。尤五怎么说法？”“他说他不写回信了。如果胡先生要运丝到上海，最好在七月底以前。”“七月底以前？”胡雪岩很认真地追问了一句。“是的。尤五说得很清楚，七月底以前。他又说，货色运过嘉兴，就是他的地段，他可以保险不出乱子。”“嗯，嗯！”胡雪岩沉吟着，从两句简单的答语中，悟出许多道理。
en: Half a month later, Chen Shilong returned to Huzhou in the same boat. He had not brought Wanxiang, but he had given her the hundred-tael banknote. She, too, had heard that Wang had been appointed prefect of Huzhou. She was willing to come for a visit, only somewhat later. Chen was anxious to return and report, and could not wait. Since the money to help her settle her affairs would have to be given anyway, he had decided to make a generous gesture and give it to her in advance. “Well done! We needn't concern ourselves with that now. What did You Laowu say?” “He said he wouldn't write a reply. If you want to ship silk to Shanghai, it would be best to do so before the end of the seventh month.” “Before the end of the seventh month?” Hu repeated earnestly. “Yes. He was very clear about that. He also said that once the goods passed Jiaxing, they would be in his territory, and he could guarantee that nothing would go wrong.” “Hmm. I see.” Hu reflected, drawing a great deal from those two simple answers.

zh: “胡先生！”陈世龙又说，“小刀会的情形，我倒打听出来许多。”“喔！”胡雪岩颇感意外，“你怎么打听到的！”他告诫过陈世龙，不许向尤五多问什么。真怕他多嘴多舌，向不相干的人去打听，这语言不谨慎的毛病，必须告诫他痛改。陈世龙看出他的不满，急忙答道：“我是在茶店里听别的茶客闲谈，留心听来的。”他听来的情形是如此：前几年上海附近，就有一股头裹红巾的人起事，官府称之为“红头造反”，其中的头脑叫做刘丽川，本来是广东人，在上海做生意，结交官场，跟洋商亦颇有往来。
en: “Mr Hu,” Chen continued, “I also found out quite a lot about the Small Swords Society.” “Oh!” Hu was rather surprised. “How did you find out?” He had warned Chen not to put any further questions to You Laowu. He very much feared that the young man had been running his mouth and making inquiries among people who had no business knowing. Such careless talk was a fault he must be firmly warned to correct. Sensing Hu's displeasure, Chen hastened to explain. “I listened carefully while other customers were talking in a teahouse.” What he had heard was this: some years earlier, men wearing red headscarves had risen near Shanghai. The authorities called it the Redhead Rebellion. One of their leaders, Liu Lichuan, was originally from Guangdong. He did business in Shanghai, cultivated official connections, and had considerable dealings with foreign merchants.

zh: “是这样的，”他第二天悄悄对陈世龙说，“我们的丝要运上海，销洋庄，只怕小刀会闹事，碰得不巧，恰恰把货色陷在里面。尤五说不定知道小刀会的内情，我就是想请教他一条避凶趋吉的路子。你懂了吧？”“懂了！”“那么，你倒想想看，你该怎么跟他说？”陈世龙思索了一会答道：“我想这样子跟他说： ‘尤五叔，胡先生和我郁四叔，叫我问候你，请老太爷的安。胡先生有几船丝想运上来，怕路上不平静，特地叫我请示你老人家，路上有没有危险？运不运，只听你老人家一句话。’”胡雪岩想了想，点点头说：“好！就是这样子说。”“不过胡先生，你总要给我一封引见的信，不然，人家晓得我是老几？”“那当然！不但有信，还有水礼让你带去。”名为“水礼”，所费不货，因为数量来得多，光是出名的“诸老大”的麻酥糖，就是两大篓，另外吃的、穿的、用的，凡是湖州的名产，几乎一样不漏，装了一船，直放松江。
en: The next day, Hu had quietly explained the matter to Chen. “This is how things stand. We want to send our silk to Shanghai for sale to foreign firms. What worries me is trouble from the Small Swords Society. With bad luck, our goods could be caught right in the middle of it. You Laowu may know what is going on inside the society. All I want is his advice on how to avoid trouble and get through safely. Do you understand?” “I do.” “Then think how you should put it to him.” After a moment's consideration, Chen answered, “I thought I would say: ‘Uncle You, Mr Hu and my Uncle Yu have sent me to ask after you and pay their respects to the old master. Mr Hu has several boatloads of silk he would like to send up, but he is afraid the route may be unsettled. He has specially sent me to ask whether there is any danger. Whether he ships the silk or not will depend entirely on your word.’” Hu considered, then nodded. “Good! Say exactly that.” “But you'll have to give me a letter of introduction, Mr Hu. Otherwise, how will he know who I am?” “Naturally. And you'll take some modest gifts as well.” Modest in name only, the gifts cost a considerable sum because there were so many of them. The famous Zhu Laoda sesame sweets alone filled two great baskets. There were foods, clothing, and useful articles: scarcely a Huzhou speciality had been omitted. They filled a boat, which sailed straight for Songjiang.

zh: “这张单子上是送尤五本人的，这张是送他们老太爷的，这张送通裕的朋友。还有这一张上的，你跟尤五说，请他派人带你去。”接过那张单子来看，上面写着“梅家弄畹香”五字，陈世龙便笑了。“你不要笑！”胡雪岩说：“不是我的相好！你也不必问是哪个的？见了她的面，你只问她一句话，愿意不愿意到湖州来玩一趟？如果她不愿意，那就算了，愿意，你原船带了她来。喏！一百两银子，说是我送她的。”“好！我晓得了。”最近因为洪秀全在金陵建都，彼此有了联络，刘丽川准备大于一番。上海的谣言甚多，有的说青浦的周立春，已经为刘丽川所联合，有的说，嘉定、太仓各地的情势都不稳，也有的说，夷场里的洋商都会支持刘丽川。这些消息，虽说是谣言，对胡雪岩却极有用处。他现在有个新的顾虑，不知道尤五是不是也跟刘丽川有联络？这一点关系极重，他必得跟郁四去商量。
en: “The things on this list are for You Laowu himself; those on this one are for the old master; those on this one are for our friends at Tongyu. And here is another list. Ask You Laowu to send someone to take you there.” Chen accepted it and smiled at the words “Wanxiang, Meijia Lane.” “Don't laugh!” Hu said. “She's not my sweetheart. And you needn't ask whose she is. When you see her, ask just one thing: would she like to visit Huzhou? If she doesn't wish to, leave it at that. If she does, bring her back in your boat. Here are a hundred taels. Tell her they're from me.” “Very well. I understand.” Recently, with Hong Xiuquan having established his capital at Jinling, Liu Lichuan had made contact with him and was preparing a major undertaking. Rumours abounded in Shanghai. Some said Liu had already allied himself with Zhou Lichun of Qingpu; others that Jiading, Taicang, and other places were unsettled; still others that the foreign merchants in the settlement would all support him. Though only rumours, this information was extremely useful to Hu. A new concern now troubled him: might You Laowu also be in touch with Liu Lichuan? The question mattered enormously. He must discuss it with Yu Si.

zh: 转述过了陈世龙的话，胡雪岩提出他的看法：“尤五给我们一个期限，说是在七月底以前，可以保险，意思是不是到了八月里就会出事？”“当然。到八月里就不敢保险了。”“照此说来，小刀会刘丽川要干些什么，尤五是知道的，这样岂不是他也要‘造反，？”胡雪岩初次在郁四面前表现了忧虑的神色：“ ’造反，两个字，不是好玩儿的！”郁四想了好一会答道，“不会！照刘丽川的情形，他恐怕是‘洪门’。漕帮跟洪门，大家河水不犯井水。再说，尤五上头还有老头子，在松江纳福，下面还有漕帮弟冗，散在各处，就算尤五自己想这样做，牵制大多，他也不敢冒失。不过江湖上讲究招呼打在先，刘丽川八月里或许要闹事，尤五是晓得的，说跟刘丽川在一起于，照我看，决不会！“这番分析，非常老到，胡雪岩心中的疑惧消失了，他很兴奋他说：“既然如此，我们的机会不可错过。郁四哥你想，如果小刀会一闹事，上海的交通或许会断，不过夷场决不会受影响，那时候外路的丝运不到上海，洋商的生意还是要照做，丝价岂不是要大涨？”“话是不错。”郁四沉吟着说，“倘或安然无事，我们这一宝押得就落空了。”
en: After repeating Chen's report, Hu offered his interpretation. “You Laowu has given us a deadline. He guarantees our safety before the end of the seventh month. Does that mean something will happen in the eighth?” “Of course. Once the eighth month comes, he won't guarantee it.” “Then he knows what Liu Lichuan and the Small Swords Society intend. Doesn't that mean he means to rebel too?” For the first time before Yu, Hu looked worried. “Rebellion is no joking matter!” Yu thought for a long while. “No. From what we know of Liu, he probably belongs to the Hongmen. The Grain Transport Brotherhood and the Hongmen keep out of each other's affairs. Besides, You Laowu has his old master living comfortably in Songjiang and members of the brotherhood scattered everywhere under him. Even if he wanted to act, there are too many restraints for him to risk anything rash. But in the brotherhoods one gives notice in advance. Liu may intend to cause trouble in the eighth month, and You Laowu knows it. As for joining him, in my opinion, certainly not.” This was an experienced and penetrating analysis. Hu's doubts vanished. “Then we mustn't miss our opportunity!” he said excitedly. “Think, Brother Yu: if the Small Swords Society rises, Shanghai's transport routes may be cut, but the foreign settlement certainly won't be affected. Silk from elsewhere won't get through, yet the foreign firms will still have to trade. Won't the price of silk soar?” “True enough,” Yu answered thoughtfully. “But if nothing happens, our gamble will come to nothing.”

zh: “也不能说落空，货色总在那里的。”“你要做我们就做。”郁四很爽朗他说，“今天六月二十，还有四十天工夫，尽来得及！”“郁四哥！”胡雪岩突然说道：“我又悟出一个道理。”胡雪岩认为尤五既然是好朋友，当然会替他设想，如果尤五参与了刘丽川的计划，则起事成败在未知之数，他的自身难保，当然不肯来管此闲事，甚至很痛快他说一句“路上不敢保险”，作为一种阻止的暗示。现在既然答应在七月底以前可以“保险”，当然是局外人，有决不会卷入漩涡的把握。这个看法，郁四完全同意，“换了我也是一样。”他说，“如果有那么样一件‘大事’在搅，老实说，朋友的什么闲事都顾不得管了。”“再说，尤五也是懂得生意的，如果夷场有麻烦，丝方面洋庄或许会停顿，他也一定会告诉我。照这样看，我们尽可以放手去做。”“对嘛！”郁四答道，“头寸调动归我负责，别样事情你来。”于是又作了一番细节上的研究，决定尽量买丝，赶七月二十运到上海，赚了钱分三份派，胡、郁各一份，另外一份留着应酬该应酬的人，到时候再商量。
en: “You can hardly call it nothing. We'll still have the goods.” “If you want to do it, we'll do it,” Yu said readily. “Today is the twentieth of the sixth month. We have forty days—plenty of time!” “Brother Yu!” Hu exclaimed. “I've just realised something else.” Since You Laowu was a good friend, he would naturally consider Hu's interests. If he had joined Liu Lichuan's scheme, the rising's outcome would be uncertain and his own safety beyond his control. He would hardly undertake someone else's business. He might simply have said that he could not guarantee the route, indirectly warning Hu not to ship. His willingness to guarantee safety before the end of the seventh month therefore showed that he was outside the affair and confident he would not be drawn into it. Yu entirely agreed. “I'd do the same. If I were involved in a great undertaking of that kind, I honestly couldn't spare a thought for a friend's incidental business.” “And You Laowu understands trade. If the settlement were in danger and foreign firms might stop buying silk, he would certainly have told me. On that reasoning, we can go ahead with confidence.” “Exactly. I'll take responsibility for arranging the funds. You handle the rest.” They discussed the details and decided to buy as much silk as possible and have it in Shanghai by the twentieth of the seventh month. The profits would be divided into three shares: one each for Hu and Yu, and a third to be distributed among those who needed rewarding, with the details to be settled later.

zh: 离开阿七那里，胡雪岩回到大经丝行，在陈世尤到上海的半个月之中，他已经把两爿号子都开了起来，丝行的“部照”是花钱顶来的，未便改名，仍叫“大经”，典了一所很象样的房子。前面是一座五开间的敞厅作店面，后面一大一小两个院子，大的那个作丝客人的客房，小的那个胡雪岩住，另外留下两间，供老张夫妇歇脚。大经的档手，照阵世龙的建议，用了那个姓黄的，名黄仪，此人相当能干，因而老张做了“垂拱而治”的老板，有事虽在一起商量，胡雪岩却常听黄仪的话。
en: Leaving A'qi's house, Hu returned to the Dajing Silk Firm. During the fortnight Chen had been away on his Shanghai journey, Hu had opened both businesses. He had paid to take over the silk firm's ministry licence, and changing its name would have been inconvenient, so it remained Dajing. He had also acquired the use of a very respectable house through a property pledge. At the front was a broad hall, five bays wide, serving as the shop; behind were two courtyards, one large and one small. The larger contained rooms for visiting silk dealers, the smaller Hu's own quarters. Two rooms were also set aside for Old Zhang and his wife when they needed to stay. On Chen's recommendation, Dajing had hired the man surnamed Huang as the manager in charge of its day-to-day business. His full name was Huang Yi, and he proved quite capable. Old Zhang consequently became a proprietor who could leave the actual running of the business to others. They consulted together when something arose, but Hu generally followed Huang's advice.

zh: “胡先生，”等听完了胡雪岩的大量购丝的宣布，黄仪说道：“五荒六月，丝本来是杀价的时候。所以我们要买丝，不能透露风声，消息一传出去，丝价马上就哄了起来。”“那么怎么办呢？”“只有多派人到乡下，不声不响地去收。只不过多费点辰光。”“就是为这点，事情一定要快。”胡雪岩又说，“销洋庄的货色，决不可以搭浆，应该啥样子就是啥样子。这一来，我们自己先要花工夫整理过，打包、装船，一个月的工夫运到上海，日子已经很紧了。”
en: “Mr Hu,” Huang said after hearing the announcement that they were to buy heavily, “the lean fifth and sixth months are normally the time to bargain silk prices down. If we're buying, we mustn't let word get out. Once it does, prices will shoot up.” “Then what should we do?” “Send more men into the countryside and buy quietly. It will just take a little longer.” “Time is precisely the trouble. We must be quick. And silk for foreign firms mustn't be doctored with sizing. It must be exactly what it claims to be. That means we must first sort and prepare it ourselves, then pack it and load it. With only a month to get it to Shanghai, we're already pressed for time.”

zh: 黄仪有些迟疑，照他的经验，如果红纸一贴，只要货色合格，有多少收多少，那丝价就一定会涨得很厉害，吃亏太大。因此，他提出两个办法，第一个办法，是由胡雪岩跟衙门里联络，设法催收通欠，税吏到门，不完不可，逼着有丝的人家非得卖去新丝纳官课不可。“不好，不好！”胡雪岩大摇其头，“这个办法太毒辣，叫老百姓骂杀！那我在湖州就站不住脚了。而且，王大老爷的官声也要紧。““那就是第二个办法，”黄仪又说，“现在织造衙门不买丝，同行生意清谈，我们打听打听，哪个手里有存货，把他吃了进来。”“这倒可以。不过货色是不是台于销洋庄，一定要弄清楚。”于是大经丝行大忙而特忙了，一车一车的丝运进来，一封一封的银子付出去，另外又雇了好些“湖丝阿姐”来理事货色。人手不够，张家母女俩都来帮忙，每天要到三更过后才回家，有时就住在店里。胡雪岩每天要到三处地方，县衙门、阿七家、阜康分号，所以一早出门，总要到晚才能回大经，然后发号施令，忙得跟阿珠说句话的工夫都没有。
en: Huang hesitated. From experience he knew that, if they put up a red notice promising to buy any quantity that met their standard, prices were bound to rise sharply, leaving them badly out of pocket. He offered two alternatives. First, Hu could use his connections at the yamen to have all outstanding taxes pressed for collection. Once the tax collectors appeared at the door, payment could not be avoided. Households with silk would be forced to sell their new silk to pay the government. “No, no!” Hu shook his head vigorously. “That's too ruthless. The people would curse me to death, and I'd never keep my footing in Huzhou. Besides, we must protect His Honour Wang's reputation.” “Then there's the second way,” Huang continued. “The imperial weaving establishment isn't buying silk at present, and our competitors' trade is slack. We can find out who has stock and buy it from them.” “That would do. But make absolutely sure their silk is suitable for the foreign market.” Dajing became extraordinarily busy. Cartloads of silk came in; packet after packet of silver went out. More women skilled in handling Huzhou silk were hired to sort and prepare it. Short of hands, they enlisted both A’zhu and her mother. Every day the two worked until after midnight before going home, and sometimes they stayed at the firm. Hu had three places to visit daily: the county yamen, A'qi's house, and Fukang's branch. He went out early and returned to Dajing only at night, then began issuing instructions. He was too busy even to exchange a word with A’zhu.

zh: 天气越来越热，事情越来越多，阿珠却丝毫不以为苦，唯一使她怏怏在心的是，找不到机会跟胡雪岩在一起。转眼二十天过去，快到七月初七，她早几天就下了决心，要在这个天上双星团圆的佳节，跟胡雪岩好好有番话说。到了那一天，她做事特别起劲，老早就告诉“饭司务”，晚饭要迟开，原来开过晚饭，还有“夜作”，她已经跟那班“湖丝阿姐”说好了，赶一赶工，做完吃饭，可以早早回家。吃过晚饭，天刚刚黑净，收拾一切该回家了，阿珠跟她娘说，家里太热，要在店里“乘风凉”。这是托词，她娘知道她的用意，不肯说破，只提醒她说：“一身的汗，不回家洗了澡再来？”洗了澡再走回来，又是一身汗，“我就在这里洗了！”她说，“叫爱珍陪我在这里。”爱珍是她家用的一个使女。等浴罢乘凉，一面望着迢迢银汉，一面在等胡雪岩。等到十点钟，爱珍都打吨了，来了个人，是陈世龙，他是五天之前，由胡雪岩派他到杭州去办事的。
en: As the weather grew hotter and the work increased, A’zhu never complained of hardship. Her one grievance was that she could find no opportunity to be with Hu. Twenty days seemed to pass in a moment, and the seventh day of the seventh month was approaching. Several days beforehand she had resolved that, on this festival when the two heavenly lovers were reunited, she would have a proper conversation with him. On the day itself, she worked with unusual energy and told the cook early that supper was to be served late. Normally there was another spell of work after supper. She had arranged with the silk workers that they would push on, finish their tasks, and then eat, allowing them to go home early. By the time supper was over, darkness had just fully fallen. Everything was put away, and it was time to leave. A’zhu told her mother that home was too hot and she would stay at the firm to enjoy the evening air. Her mother understood the excuse but did not expose it. “After sweating all day, won't you go home for a bath and come back?” she merely asked. But she would sweat again on the walk back. “I'll wash here. Let Aizhen stay with me.” Aizhen was their maid. After washing, A’zhu sat in the cool air, gazing at the distant Milky Way and waiting for Hu. By ten o'clock even Aizhen was nodding. Then someone arrived: Chen Shilong, whom Hu had sent to Hangzhou on business five days before.

zh: “你什么时候到的？”“刚刚到。”陈世龙说，“我不晓得你在这里，我把东西带来了。”“什么东西？”“吃的、用的都有，衣料、香粉、香椎、沙核桃糖、蔬菜。有胡先生叫我买的，有我自己买的。”“你自己买的什么？”“一把檀香扇。送你的。”“你又要去乱花钱！”阿珠埋怨他，“买一把细蒲扇我还用得着，买什么檀香扇？‘这是违心之论，实际上她正在想要这么一把扇子。陈世龙觉得无趣，“那倒是我错了！”他怔怔地望着她。阿珠心中歉然，但也不想再解释这件事，问道：“你吃过饭没有？”“饭倒不想吃。最好来碗冰凉的绿豆汤。”“有红枣百合汤！”明明可以叫爱珍去盛来，阿珠却亲自动手，等他狼吞虎咽吃完便又问：“要不要了？”“我再吃，胡先生怕就没得吃了。”“不要紧！他也吃不了多少的。”她把自己的一份，省下来给餍陈世龙的口腹。第二碗红枣百合汤吃到一半，胡雪岩回来了，陈世龙慌忙站起来招呼。
en: “When did you get back?” “Just now,” Chen answered. “I didn't know you were here. I've brought the things.” “What things?” “All sorts of food and household things: dress materials, face powder, torreya nuts, walnut sweets, and vegetables. Some Mr Hu asked me to buy, and some I bought myself.” “What did you buy yourself?” “A sandalwood fan. For you.” “Spending money you shouldn't again!” A’zhu reproached him. “I could use a finely woven palm-leaf fan. Why buy sandalwood?” She was speaking against her own wishes: in fact, she had been longing for just such a fan. Chen felt rebuffed. “Then I've made a mistake.” He stared at her blankly. A’zhu felt guilty, but did not want to explain further. “Have you eaten?” she asked. “I don't feel like a meal. What I'd really like is a bowl of chilled mung-bean soup.” “There's red-date and lily-bulb soup.” She could easily have sent Aizhen for it, but fetched it herself. When he had gulped it down, she asked, “Would you like more?” “If I have any more, there may be none left for Mr Hu.” “It doesn't matter. He won't eat much.” She gave up her own portion to satisfy Chen's appetite. He was halfway through his second bowl when Hu returned, and hurriedly rose to greet him.

zh: 胡雪岩要跟他谈话，便顾不得阿珠，一坐下来就问杭州的情形。“老刘有回信在这里！”陈世龙把刘庆生的信递了过去。信上谈到代理湖州府、县两公库的事。胡雪岩在这里把公款都扯了来买丝了，而应解藩库的公款，催索甚急。派陈世龙专程到杭州给刘庆主送信，就是要他解决这个难题。刘庆生走了刘二的路子，转托藩衙门管库的书办，答应缓期到月底，必须解清。“老刘说，日子过得很快，要请胡先生早点预备。一面他在杭州想办法，不过有没有把握，很难说。”“他在杭州怎么样想办法呢？”“他没有跟我说，不过我也有点晓得。”陈世龙说：“第一是到同行那里去商量，有湖州的汇款，最好划到阜康来开票子……”“啊！”胡雪岩矍然一惊，“这就是他冒失了。杭州开出票子，在这里要照兑，这个办法要先告诉我，不然岂不是‘打回票’了？”“老刘现在还在进行，等有了眉目，自然会写信来的。”陈世龙停了一下又说：“另外，他跟信和在商量，到时候这里没有款子去，请信和先垫一笔。”“那么你晓不晓得信和张胖子怎么说法呢？”“听说信和自己的头寸也很紧。”
en: Wanting to speak to Chen, Hu had no attention to spare for A’zhu. The moment he sat down he asked about Hangzhou. “Here's Old Liu's reply.” Chen handed him Liu Qingsheng's letter. It concerned Fukang's handling of the public funds of both the Huzhou prefecture and the county. Hu had drawn all the money into his silk purchases, but the provincial treasury was pressing urgently for the sums due to it. Chen's special journey to Hangzhou with a letter to Liu had been intended to resolve this difficulty. Through Liu Er, Liu Qingsheng had approached the clerk responsible for the treasury's accounts, who had agreed to a delay until the end of the month, when everything must be remitted in full. “Old Liu says time passes quickly, and asks you to make preparations early. He's trying to find a way in Hangzhou too, though it's hard to say whether he'll succeed.” “What is he trying?” “He didn't tell me, but I know a little. First, he's consulting other banks. If they have remittances payable in Huzhou, he'd like them transferred to Fukang, which would issue the drafts—” “What!” Hu started. “That's rash of him. Drafts issued in Hangzhou must be honoured here. He has to tell me before doing anything of the kind. Otherwise, won't we end up refusing payment?” “He's still making inquiries. When something definite emerges, he'll naturally write.” Chen paused, then added, “He's also talking to Xinhe. If we can't send the money in time, he wants them to advance it.” “Do you know what Fat Zhang at Xinhe says?” “I hear their own funds are very tight.”

zh: 胡雪岩默然。心里在盘算着，月底的限期，决不可能再缓。如果说小刀会真的闹事。“江南大营”一方面少了上海附近的饷源，另一方面又要派兵剿办，那时候来催浙江的“饷”，一定急如星火。倘或无以应付，藩司报抚台、抚台奏朝廷，追究责任，王有龄的干系甚重。“月底以前，一定要想办法解清。”胡雪岩说，“世龙，你替我写封信。”信仍旧是写给刘庆生的，关照他预先在同行之中接头短期的借款，以八月底为期，能借好多少，立刻写信来，不足之数在湖州另想办法。至于由杭州阜康出票，湖州阜康照兑的汇划，暂是不必进行，等全部款子筹划妥当了再说。“胡先生，”陈世龙捏着笔说，“有句话，我好不好问？”“你问，不要紧。”“我要请问胡先生，八月底到期的款子，是不是等在上海卖掉了丝来还？”“不错。”胡雪岩答道：“如果一时卖不掉，我还有个办法，在上海先做押款。当然，最好不要走这条路，这条路一走，让人家看出我们的实力不足，以后再要变把戏就难了。”陈世龙对这句话，大有领悟，“把戏人人会变，各有巧妙不同”，巧妙就在如何不拆穿把戏上面。
en: Hu fell silent and calculated. The deadline at the month's end could not possibly be extended again. If the Small Swords Society did rise, the Jiangnan Grand Camp would both lose revenue from the Shanghai area and have to send troops to suppress it. Its demands on Zhejiang for military funds would then become desperately urgent. If the province could not meet them, the treasurer would report to the governor, the governor would memorialise the throne, and responsibility would be investigated. Wang would be gravely implicated. “We must find a way to remit everything before the month's end,” Hu said. “Shilong, write a letter for me.” It was again addressed to Liu Qingsheng. He was to approach the other banks in advance for short-term loans repayable at the end of the eighth month and write immediately with the amount he could obtain. Any shortfall would be raised in Huzhou. As for drafts issued by Fukang in Hangzhou and payable by Fukang in Huzhou, that arrangement should be suspended until all the necessary funds had been secured. “Mr Hu,” Chen said, holding his brush, “may I ask something?” “Go ahead.” “Will the loans due at the end of the eighth month be repaid from the silk sold in Shanghai?” “Exactly. If the silk can't be sold immediately, I have another way: we can borrow against it in Shanghai. Naturally, I'd rather not. Once we do that, people will see that our resources are limited. It will be harder to work another trick after that.” Chen understood a great deal from these words. Anyone could perform tricks, but the skill varied. The real art lay in keeping the mechanism from being exposed.

zh: 一面想，一面写信。写完又谈丝生意，现在到了快起运的时候了。胡雪岩的意思，仍旧要陈世龙押运。陈世龙一诺无辟。接下来便谈水运的细节，一直谈到货色到上海进堆栈。然后又研究在上海是不是要设号子？话越来越多，谈到深宵，兴犹未已。这一来便冷落了阿珠。她先还能耐心等待，但对胡雪岩那种视如不见的态度，反感越来越浓，几次想站起身走，无奈那张藤椅象有个钩子，紧紧钩住了她的衣服。心里不断在想：等一下非好好数落他几句不可。到钟打一点，胡雪岩伸个懒腰说，“有话明天再说吧！我实在困了。”“我明天一早就来。”陈世龙说，“杭州买的东西都还在船上。”“不要紧，不要紧。你也好好歇一歇，明天下午来好了。”说到这里他才发现阿珠，不由得诧异：“咦，你还在这里？”阿珠真想回他一句：你到此刻才知道？可是话到嘴边，又忍了回去。“不早了！世龙正好送你回去。”这一下，她可真的忍不住了。等了半天，等到“送回去”这句话，难道自己在这里枯守着，就为等陈世龙来送？她恨他一点没有把她放在心上，因而扭头就走，跌跌冲冲地，真叫“一怒而去”！
en: He thought as he wrote. Once the letter was finished, they discussed the silk business. Shipment was approaching, and Hu wanted Chen to escort the cargo again. Chen readily agreed. They went through the details of transport by water, right up to the goods' arrival at a Shanghai warehouse. Then they considered whether to establish a firm there. One subject led to another, and deep into the night they were still absorbed in discussion. A’zhu had been left entirely out. At first she could wait patiently, but her resentment of Hu's seeming inability to see her grew steadily. Several times she wanted to get up and leave, yet the wicker chair seemed to have a hook that held her clothes fast. She kept thinking that, when she had the chance, she would give him a proper scolding. At one o'clock Hu stretched. “We can talk tomorrow. I'm really tired.” “I'll come first thing in the morning,” Chen said. “The things from Hangzhou are still on the boat.” “No hurry, no hurry. Get some proper rest yourself. Tomorrow afternoon will do.” Only then did Hu notice A’zhu. “Why! Are you still here?” She longed to retort, “Have you only just realised?” but held back the words. “It's late. Shilong can see you home.” That was more than she could bear. After all her waiting, this was what she got: an offer to send her home. Had she sat there all that time merely waiting for Chen to escort her? Furious that Hu had given her no thought at all, she turned and stumbled away, leaving in a true burst of anger.

zh: 胡雪岩和陈世龙都是一愣，也都是立刻发觉了她的异样，不约而同地赶了上去。“阿珠，阿珠！”“张小姐！”两个人都在喊，阿珠把脚停下来了。胡雪岩很机警，只对陈世龙说：“你自己走好了。”“好！”陈世龙装得若无其事地跟阿珠道别：“张小姐，明朝会！”她不能不理，也答一声：“明朝会！”然后仍旧回到原来那张藤椅上坐下。“天气太热！”胡雪岩跟过去，陪着笑说：“最好弄点清心去火的东西来吃。”她以为他一定会问：为什么发这么大的脾气？那一来就好接着他的话发牢骚。不想是这么一句话，一时倒叫人发不出脾气，只好不理他，作为报复。“喔，有红枣百合汤，好极了！”胡雪岩指着陈世龙吃剩下的那只碗说，“好不好给我也盛一碗来？味道大概不错。”有心答他一句：吃完了！又怕这一来，真的变成反目，结果还是去盛了来，送到胡雪岩手里。但心里却越发委屈，眼眶一热，流了两滴眼泪。
en: Hu and Chen both stared, then immediately recognised that something was wrong and hurried after her. “A’zhu! A’zhu!” “Miss Zhang!” At their combined calls she stopped. Quick to understand, Hu merely told Chen, “You go on by yourself.” “Very well.” Chen took leave of A’zhu as though nothing had happened. “Until tomorrow, Miss Zhang.” She could not ignore him and answered, “Until tomorrow.” Then she returned to her wicker chair. “This weather is too hot,” Hu said, following her with an apologetic smile. “The best thing would be something cooling to clear the heat.” She had expected him to ask why she was so angry, which would have given her an opening for her complaints. Instead he said this, leaving her unable to vent her temper. She could only punish him with silence. “Oh, red-date and lily-bulb soup! Excellent!” Pointing to Chen's empty bowl, he asked, “Could you fetch me a bowl too? It must be delicious.” She wanted to say there was none left, but feared that might turn their disagreement into a real quarrel. In the end, she fetched a bowl and put it in his hands. Yet she felt more aggrieved than ever. Her eyes grew hot, and two tears fell.

zh: “这为啥？”胡雪岩不能再装糊涂，“好端端地哭！如果是哪个得罪了你，尽管说，我想也没有哪个敢得罪你。”活是说得好听，却只是口惠，实际上他不知存着什么心思？跟他呕气无用，还是要跟他好好谈一谈。“你晓不晓得，我特为在这里等你？”她试干了眼泪问。“啊呀！”胡雪岩故意装得大惊小怪的，敲敲自己的额角，“我实在忙得头都昏了，居然会没有想到你在这里是等我。对不起，对不起！“说着便拉过她的手来，揉着、搓着，使得阿珠啼笑皆非，弄不清自己的感觉是爱还是恨？最为难的还是一腔幽怨，无从细诉。她一直在想，以他的机警而善于揣摩人情，一定会知道她的心事，然则一直没有表示，无非故意装糊涂。但有时也会自我譬解，归出于他太忙，没有工夫来想这些。此刻既然要正正经经来谈，首先就得弄清楚，他到底真的是忙想不到，还是想过了，有别样的打算？就是这一点，也很难有恰当的说法，她一个人偏着头，只想心事，把胡雪岩的那些不相干的闲话，都当作耳边风。
en: “What's this?” Hu could no longer pretend not to understand. “Why cry when nothing's wrong? If someone's offended you, tell me. Though I can't imagine anyone daring to do that.” Pleasant words, but words were all he offered. What was he really thinking? Sulking would achieve nothing. She must have a serious talk with him. “Do you know that I stayed here especially to wait for you?” she asked, wiping her tears. “Good heavens!” Hu made a great show of astonishment and tapped his forehead. “I'm so busy I can hardly think. Imagine my not realising you were waiting for me! I'm sorry, I'm sorry.” He took her hand and held it between his, leaving her uncertain whether to laugh or cry, love him or resent him. Hardest of all was that she could find no way to explain the feelings that had troubled her for so long. She had always thought that a man so quick-witted and so good at reading people must understand what she wanted. If he had given no sign, surely he was deliberately pretending otherwise. Yet sometimes she comforted herself with the thought that he was simply too busy to consider such things. Now that they were to talk seriously, she must first discover whether he truly had had no time to think or had thought about it and made other plans. Even that was hard to put into words. She sat with her head tilted, absorbed in her thoughts, letting his irrelevant chatter pass unheard.

zh: “咦！”胡雪岩推推她问道：“你是哑巴，还是聋子？”“我不哑不聋，只懒得说。要说，也不知道从哪里说起！”语气平静，话锋却颇为严重，胡雪岩自然听得出来，他原有装些糊涂，最近更有了别样心想，所以越发小心，只这样问道：“什么事？这样子为难！”“难的是我自己说不出口。”这句话答得很好，虽说含蓄，其实跟说明了一样，胡雪岩不能装糊涂了，“喔，原来如此。说实话，你是说不出口，我是忙不过来。”他说，“你当我没有想过？我想过十七八遍了，我托张胖子跟你娘说的话，绝对算数。不过要有工夫来办。现在这样子，你自己看见、听见的。我没有想到，这一趟到湖州来，会结交郁四这个朋友，做洋庄，开阜康分号，都是预先不曾打算到的。你刚才听见的，我杭州的头寸这么紧，等着我去料理，都抽不出空来。”就这一番话，阿珠象吃了一服消痰化气的汤头，“你看你，”她不由得有了笑容，“我不过说了一句，你咭咭呱呱一大套。没有人说得过你。”“我不说又不好，说了又不好！真正难伺候。好了，好了，我们谈点别的。”
en: “Well?” Hu nudged her. “Have you gone dumb, or deaf?” “Neither. I simply don't feel like talking. And if I did, I wouldn't know where to begin.” Her tone was calm, but the words were serious, as Hu naturally recognised. He had indeed been pretending not to understand, and lately he had formed other ideas, making him all the more cautious. “What is it that's so difficult?” he asked. “The difficulty is that I can't say it myself.” It was a good reply. Though indirect, it was as clear as an outright statement. Hu could no longer evade it. “Oh, so that's it. To tell the truth, you can't bring yourself to say it, and I can't find the time to act. Do you think I haven't considered it? I've thought it over seventeen or eighteen times. I absolutely stand by what I asked Fat Zhang to tell your mother. But I need time to arrange things. You've seen and heard how matters are just now. I never expected this visit to Huzhou to bring me a friend like Yu Si. Trading with foreign firms and opening Fukang's branch were both unplanned. You heard just now how tight my funds are in Hangzhou. They need me there to put things right, yet I can't even get away.” This speech soothed A’zhu like a dose of medicine that relieved a choking pressure. A smile came to her face. “Look at you! I say one thing, and out comes a whole torrent. Nobody can argue with you.” “It's wrong if I say nothing and wrong if I speak! You're terribly hard to please. All right, all right. Let's talk about something else.”

zh: 所谈的自然也不脱大经丝行这个范围。阿珠最注意的是胡雪岩的行踪，话锋中隐约表示，她也想到上海去玩一趟。胡雪岩说天气太热，一动不如一静，同时老张是一定要去的，她该留在湖州，帮着她娘照料丝行。这是极有道理的话，阿珠不作声了。“你看，”他忽然问道：“陈世龙这个人怎么样呢？”是哪方面怎么样呢？阿珠心里想替陈世龙说几句好话，却不知道该怎么说？只好笼统的答道：“蛮能干的！”“我是说他做人，你看是老实一路呢？还是浮滑一路呢？”老实就是无用，浮滑就是靠不住。阿珠觉得他的话，根本不能回答，便摇摇头说：“都不是！”“不老实，也不浮滑，普普通通。是不是呢？”“普普通通”也不是句好话，她不愿委屈陈世龙，又答了个：“不是！”“左也不是，右也不是。那么你说，陈世龙到底是怎么样一个人呢？”一半是无从回答，一半由于他那咄咄逼人的词色，阿珠有些恼羞成怒了，“我不晓得！”她的声音又快又尖，“陈世龙关我什么事？请你少来问我。”
en: Their conversation naturally remained within the affairs of the Dajing Silk Firm. What interested A’zhu most was where Hu would be going, and she hinted that she too would like to visit Shanghai. He replied that in such heat it was better to stay put than travel. Besides, Old Zhang would certainly be going, and she ought to remain in Huzhou to help her mother look after the business. This was so reasonable that she said nothing. “Tell me,” he suddenly asked, “what do you think of Chen Shilong?” In what respect? She wanted to say something good about Chen, but did not know what to say. “He's very capable,” she answered broadly. “I mean his character. Would you call him the simple, honest sort, or the slick sort?” Simple and honest would mean useless; slick would mean untrustworthy. A’zhu felt that the question could not be answered on those terms. She shook her head. “Neither.” “Neither simple nor slick. Just ordinary. Is that it?” Ordinary was hardly a compliment either. Unwilling to do Chen an injustice, she again said, “No.” “Not this and not that. Then tell me what kind of person he is.” Half unable to answer, half angered by his pressing manner, she snapped, “I don't know! What has Chen Shilong to do with me? Please stop asking.” Her voice was sharp and quick.

zh: 她气得脸红，呼吸急促。胡雪岩仍笑嘻嘻地看着她，让她越发不自在。阿珠独自生了半天闷气，察觉他的目光后，转过身去，把蒲扇拿在身前，嘴里还咕哝了一句：“贼秃嘻嘻！”“好了，好了！都是我不好。天有点凉了，到里头来坐。”这句话提醒了她，夜这么深了，到底回去不回去？要回去，就得赶紧走，而且要胡雪岩送，一则街上看到了不便，再则也不愿开口向他央求。不走呢，似乎更不好。虽然也在这里住过，那都是跟娘在一起，不怕旁人说闲话，现在是孤男寡女，情形又不同了。“真的不理我？”胡雪岩又说，“那我就陪你在这里坐一夜。不过受了凉，明天生病，是你自己吃苦头。”听得他温情款款，她的气也消了，“没有看到过你这种人，”她说：“滑得象泥鳅一样！”
en: Her face flushed with anger and her breathing quickened. Hu kept watching her with a smile, making her still more uncomfortable. She sat fuming for some time. When she noticed his gaze, she turned away, held her palm-leaf fan before her, and muttered, “Smirking rogue!” “All right, all right. It's all my fault. The night's getting cool. Come and sit inside.” This reminded her how late it was. Should she go home? If so, she must leave at once, and Hu would have to escort her. Being seen in the street together would be awkward, and she did not want to ask him for the favour. Yet staying seemed worse. She had slept here before, but always with her mother, which left no grounds for gossip. Now she and Hu would be alone, and that was different. “Are you really going to ignore me?” Hu continued. “Then I'll sit out here with you all night. But if you catch cold and fall ill tomorrow, you'll be the one to suffer.” His affectionate tone softened her anger. “I've never seen anyone like you,” she said. “You're as slippery as a loach!”

adaptation.reason: 中性化已知未成年人阿珠被情色化凝视的句子（8117、8119），保留其余对话与去留顾虑。

zh: 这是说他对她的态度，不可捉摸。胡雪岩无可辩解，却有些着急，明天一早还有许多事等着自己料理，得要早早上床，去寻个好梦，这样白耗工夫，岂不急人？想一想，只有这样暗示：“那么你坐一下，我先去抹个身。”抹过身自然该上床了。听得这话，他急她也急，便不再多作考虑，站起身来说，“我要回去了。”“回去？”胡雪岩心想，这得找人来送，当然是自己义不容辞，一来一去又费辰光又累，实在不想动，便功她说：“何必？马马虎虎睡一会，天就亮了。”阿珠犹在迟疑，一眼瞥见在打瞌睡的爱珍，顿感释然，有爱珍陪着，就不必怕人说闲话。
en: She meant that his attitude towards her was impossible to pin down. Hu had no answer, but he was growing impatient. There was much to do first thing tomorrow; he needed to get to bed and enjoy a good night's sleep. How could he help chafing at this waste of time? After a moment's thought, he could only hint, “Sit here a little longer, then. I'll go and sponge myself down.” Naturally, bed would follow. Hearing his impatience, she became anxious too and, without further deliberation, stood up. “I'm going home.” “Home?” That would mean finding someone to escort her. Of course, he could hardly refuse to go himself, but the journey there and back would take time and tire him, and he really did not want to stir. He tried to persuade her. “Why bother? Get whatever sleep you can here. It'll be daylight soon.” Still hesitating, A’zhu glanced at the dozing Aizhen and felt relieved. With her maid to accompany her, she need not fear gossip.

zh: 于是又说了两句闲话，各自归寝，却部不能入梦。胡雪岩心里在想，阿珠这件事真有点进退两难，照她的脾气，最好成天守在一起，说说笑笑，如果嫁个老老实实的小伙子，一夫一妻，必定恩爱。象自己这种性情，将来难免三妻四妾，阿珠一定会吃醋，何苦闹得鸡犬不宁？于是他又想到陈世龙。看样子，阿珠并不讨厌他，只是她此刻一心要做“胡家的人”，不会想到陈世龙身上。倘或一方面慢慢让她疏远，一方面尽量让陈世龙跟她接近，两下一凑，这头姻缘就可以成功了。
en: After a few more words they went to their separate rooms, but neither could sleep. Hu thought that the affair with A’zhu had become a real dilemma. With her temperament, she would prefer to be together all day, laughing and talking. Married to a straightforward young man, with just the two of them, she would surely be happy. With his own disposition, however, he would inevitably have several wives and concubines in time. A’zhu would be jealous. Why invite endless domestic turmoil? His thoughts returned to Chen. She did not seem to dislike him; she simply had her heart set on joining the Hu household and could think of nobody else. If Hu gradually let her grow distant while giving Chen every opportunity to draw close, the two movements together might produce a marriage.

zh: 这一成功，绝对是好事。阿珠的父母，必定喜欢这个女婿，他们小夫妻也必定心满意足，饮水思源，都是自己的功劳。别的不说，起码陈世龙就会死心塌地，帮自己好好做生意。打定了主意，恬然入梦。第二天一早起身，盘算了一下，这天该办的大事有两件。第一件是王有龄要晋省述职，说过要约他一起同行，得去讨个回话。第二件是跟郁四去商量，哪里设法调一笔款子，把月底应解藩库的公款应付过去。
en: Such a marriage would be an excellent thing. A’zhu's parents would certainly welcome the son-in-law, and the young couple would be entirely satisfied. Remembering the source of their happiness, they would credit Hu with it all. At the very least, Chen would devote himself wholeheartedly to helping Hu's business. With this settled in his mind, Hu fell peacefully asleep. Rising early the next morning, he reckoned that he had two major matters to attend to. First, Wang was going to the provincial capital to report on his administration and had invited Hu to travel with him. Hu must obtain a definite answer about the arrangements. Second, he must ask Yu where they could raise funds to cover the public money due at the provincial treasury by the month's end.

zh: “你来得正好！”王有龄一见他便这样说：“我正要找你，有两件事跟你商量。先说一件，要你捐钱。”这句话没头没脑，听不明白，但不管是捐什么，没有推辞的道理，所以他很豪爽地答道：“雪公说好了，捐多少？一句话。”“是这样，我想给书院里加此‘膏火’银子，你看如何？”寒士多靠书院月课得奖的少数银子，名为夜来读书的“膏火”所需，实在是用来养家活口的。“这是好事！”胡雪岩也懂这些名堂，“我赞成！捐二百两够不够？”“你出手倒真阔！”王有龄笑道，“你一共捐二百两银子。一百两书院膏火，另外一百两捐给育婴堂，让他们多置几亩田。”“好，就这样。银子缴到哪里？”
en: “You've come at just the right time!” Wang said on seeing him. “I was about to send for you. I have two things to discuss. First, I want a donation from you.” This came without explanation, and Hu did not understand. Whatever the donation was for, however, there was no reason to refuse. He answered generously, “Name the amount, Mr Xuexuan. Just say the word.” “I want to increase the academy's study allowances. What do you think?” Poor scholars often depended on the small awards given for the academy's monthly exercises. Nominally these paid for lamp oil for night study; in reality they fed their families. Hu understood such arrangements. “An excellent cause! I approve. Would two hundred taels be enough?” “You certainly give generously!” Wang laughed. “Two hundred taels in all: a hundred for the academy's allowances and a hundred for the foundling home, so that it can buy a few more mu of land.” “Agreed. Where should I pay it?”

zh: “这不忙。我谈第二件。”王有龄又说，“本县的团练，已经谈妥当了。现在局势越来越紧，保境安民，耽误不得，所以我马上要到省里去一趟，说停当了，好动手。预备明天就走，你来不来得及？““明天就走哪里来得及？”胡雪岩想了想答道：“最快也得三天以后，我才能动身。”“那么，你一到省就来看我。还有件事，解省的公款怎么样了？上面问起来，我好有句话交代。”这是个难题。王有龄不上省，延到月底缴没有关系，既已上省，藩司会问：怎么不顺便报解？这话在王有龄很难回答，自己要替他设想。“讲是讲好了，月底解清。不过雪公不能空手上省。我看这样，”胡雪岩说：“雪公能不能缓三天，等我一起走？这三天工夫当中，我有雪公凑五万现款出来。这样子上省，面子也好看些。”王有龄想了一下答道，“那也好！”事情说定了，胡雪岩急于想去凑那五万现款，随即去找郁四，说明经过。彼此休戚相关，而且郁四早就拍过胸脯，头寸调度，归他负责，所以一口答应，等临走那天，一定可以凑足。
en: “There's no hurry. Now for the second matter.” Wang continued, “The county militia arrangements have been settled. The situation is growing more urgent, and protecting the district and its people cannot wait. I must go to the provincial capital at once and settle the matter there so that we can begin. I intend to leave tomorrow. Can you be ready?” “How could I be ready tomorrow?” Hu considered. “Three days from now is the earliest I could leave.” “Then come and see me as soon as you arrive. And one more thing: what is happening about the money due to the province? I must have an answer if my superiors ask.” That was difficult. If Wang stayed in Huzhou, payment at the month's end would be acceptable. But once he went to the capital, the treasurer would ask why he had not brought the money with him. Wang would find that hard to answer, and Hu must think for him. “We agreed to remit it all by the month's end, but you can't go empty-handed. Could you delay three days and travel with me? In those three days I'll put together fifty thousand taels in cash for you. You'd arrive looking much better.” Wang considered. “That will do.” Once it was settled, Hu, eager to raise the money, went straight to Yu and explained. Their fortunes were bound together, and Yu had already pledged to take responsibility for the funds. He agreed at once: the full sum would be ready by the day they left.

zh: 于是胡雪岩回到大经，把黄仪和老张找来，说三天以后就要动身。问他们货色能不能都料理好，装船同走？“来不及！”黄仪答道：“我今天一早，仔细算过了，总要五天。”“今天七月初八，加五天就是十三，二十以前赶得到上海。”胡雪岩灵机一动，“我跟王老爷已经约好，不能失信，我们十一先走，你们随后来，我在杭州等。”接着，他又对老张说，“阿珠想到上海去玩一趟，就让她去好了。”“好的！”老张深表同意，“阿珠这一向也辛苦，人都瘦了，让她到上海去逛一逛。”
en: Returning to Dajing, Hu summoned Huang Yi and Old Zhang. He told them he would be leaving in three days and asked whether all the goods could be prepared, loaded, and sent off with him. “There isn't time,” Huang answered. “I worked it out carefully this morning. We need five days.” “Today is the eighth of the seventh month. Five more days brings us to the thirteenth. You can still reach Shanghai before the twentieth.” An idea came to Hu. “I've already arranged things with His Honour Wang and can't break my word. We'll leave on the eleventh. You follow afterwards, and I'll wait in Hangzhou.” Then he turned to Old Zhang. “A’zhu wants to see Shanghai. Let her go along.” “Certainly!” Old Zhang warmly agreed. “She's worked hard lately and has grown thinner. Let her have a look around Shanghai.”

zh: “还有件事，”胡雪岩忽然有个灵感，“我们要做好事！”黄仪和老张都一愣，不知道他何以爆出这么句话来，好事怎么做法？为谁做好事？当然，胡雪岩会有解释：他是从王有龄那里得来的启示，“做生意第一要市面平静，平静才会兴旺，我们做好事，就是求市面平静。”他喜欢引用谚语，这时又很恰当地用了一句：“ ‘饥寒起盗心’，吃亏的还是有钱的人，所以做生意赚了钱，要做好事。今年我们要发米票、施棉衣、舍棺材。”“原来是这些好事！”黄仪答道，“那都是冬天，到年近岁逼才办，时候还早。”“现在热天也有好事好做，秋老虎还厉害得很，施茶、施药都是很实惠的好事。”胡雪岩最有决断，而况似此小事，所以这样嘱咐：“老黄，说做就做！今天就办。”黄仪深知他的脾气，做事要又快又好，钱上面很舍得。这就好办了！当天大经丝行门口便出现了一座木架子，上面两口可容一担水的茶缸，竹筒斜削，安上一个柄，当做茶杯，茶水中加上清火败毒的药料。另外门上一张簇新的梅红笺，写的是：“本行敬送辟瘟丹、诸葛行军散，请内洽索取。”
en: “There's something else.” Hu suddenly had another inspiration. “We must do good works!” Both Huang and Old Zhang stared, wondering what had prompted the announcement. What good works, and for whom? Naturally, Hu explained. The idea had come from Wang. “The first thing business needs is a peaceful market. Peace brings prosperity. Our good works will help maintain that peace.” Fond of proverbs, he found an apt one. “‘Hunger and cold turn men's thoughts to theft.’ And who suffers? The wealthy. So when business makes us money, we must do some good. This year we'll distribute rice vouchers, give away padded clothes, and provide coffins for those who can't afford them.” “Oh, that kind of good work,” Huang replied. “Those things are usually done in winter, towards the year's end. There's plenty of time.” “There are good works to do in hot weather too. The fierce late heat of autumn is still to come. Giving out tea and medicines is useful help.” Hu was decisive, especially over such a small matter. “Old Huang, once we've decided, let's act. Start today.” Huang knew his temperament well: work must be done quickly and properly, and money would be freely provided. That made it easy. The same day, a wooden stand appeared outside Dajing. On it stood two tea vats, each large enough for a full carrying load of water. Bamboo tubes, cut diagonally and fitted with handles, served as cups. The tea contained medicinal ingredients intended to clear internal heat and counter toxins. A fresh sheet of plum-red paper on the door announced: “Biwen Pills and Zhuge Marching Powder given free by this firm. Please inquire within.”

zh: 这一来大经丝行就热闹了，一下午就送掉了两百多瓶诸葛行军散，一百多包辟瘟丹，黄仪深以为患，到晚来向胡雪岩诉苦，一则怕难以为继，二则伯讨药的人太多，影响生意。“丝也收得差不多了，生意不会受大影响，讨药的人虽多。实在也花不了多少钱。第一天人多是一定的，过两天就好了，讨过的人，不好意思再来讨，再说，药又不是铜细，越多越好。不要紧！”“我倒有个办法。”陈世龙接口说道：“我们送的药要定制，分量不必这么多。包装纸上要红字印明白：”大经丝行敬送‘。装诸葛行军散的小瓷瓶，也要现烧，把大经丝行印上去。““这要大动干戈，今年来不及，只好明年再说。”黄仪是不愿多找麻烦的语气。胡雪岩当时虽无表示，事后把陈世龙找了来说：“世龙，你的脑筋很好。说实话，施茶施药的用意，只有你懂，好事不会白做的，我是借此扬名，不过这话不好说出口，你倒猜到了，实在聪明。”
en: Dajing promptly became a busy place. In a single afternoon, more than two hundred bottles of Zhuge Marching Powder and a hundred packets of Biwen Pills were given away. Huang was deeply troubled. That evening he complained to Hu that, first, they might not be able to keep it up and, second, so many people coming for medicine would interfere with trade. “We've nearly finished buying the silk, so business won't be much affected. There may be many people, but the cost is really small. Naturally, the first day draws a crowd. It'll be better in a day or two. People who've already received medicine will be embarrassed to ask again. Besides, medicine isn't copper cash: more isn't always better. Don't worry.” “I have an idea,” Chen put in. “We should have the medicines specially prepared, in smaller quantities per package. The wrappers should be printed in red: ‘Presented by the Dajing Silk Firm.’ The little porcelain bottles for the Marching Powder should be specially fired too, with Dajing's name on them.” “That would take a great deal of arranging. It's too late this year. We'd have to leave it till next year.” Huang plainly did not want additional trouble. Hu said nothing then, but afterwards called Chen aside. “Shilong, you have a good head. To tell the truth, you're the only one who understands what I mean by giving out tea and medicines. Good works won't go unrewarded. I'm using them to make a name for myself, though I couldn't say so aloud. You guessed it. Very clever.”

zh: 得了这番鼓励，陈世龙颇为兴奋，很诚恳地答道：“我跟胡先生也学了好多东西。”“慢慢来！你只要跟我跟长了，包你有出息。现在，我再跟你说件事。这趟阿珠到杭州，你多照应照应她，她是伢儿脾气，喜欢热闹，船上没事，你多陪陪她。”“我晓得了！”晓得了？胡雪岩心想，未见得！话还要再点一两句。“世龙！”他态度轻松地问道：“你倒说说看，我跟阿珠是怎么回事？”这叫陈世龙怎么说？他笑一笑，露出雪白的一嘴牙齿，显得稚气可掬地。“这有什么好碍口的？你尽管说。”陈世龙逼得无法，只好说了：“胡先生不是很喜欢张小姐吗？外面都说，胡先生在湖州还要立一处公馆。”“对！我在湖州倒想安个家，来来往往，起居饮食都方便。不过，我跟阿珠是干干净净的。”这前后两截话，有些接不上榫头，陈世龙倒愣住了，“莫非胡先生另有打算？”他问。“现在也还谈不到。等我下趟来再说。”
en: Chen was excited by this encouragement. “I've learned a great deal from you too, Mr Hu,” he answered earnestly. “Take your time. Stay with me long enough, and I guarantee you'll get somewhere. Now there's something else. When A’zhu goes to Hangzhou this time, look after her. She has a child's disposition and likes company and excitement. There's nothing to do on a boat, so keep her company.” “I understand.” Did he? Hu doubted it. He would need another hint or two. “Shilong,” he asked casually, “what do you make of A’zhu and me?” How could Chen answer that? He merely smiled, showing a row of white teeth and looking touchingly boyish. “There's no need to feel awkward. Say what you think.” Pressed beyond escape, Chen answered, “Aren't you very fond of Miss Zhang? Everyone says you're going to establish a household here in Huzhou as well.” “Yes, I would like a home in Huzhou. Coming and going, I'd have somewhere comfortable to stay and eat. But nothing has happened between A’zhu and me.” The two parts of this statement did not quite fit together. Chen was puzzled. “Do you have some other plan?” “It's too early to say. We'll see when I come again.”

zh: “那么，”陈世龙想了想，替阿珠有些忧虑和不平，“张小姐呢？她一片心都在胡先生身上。”“这我知道。就为这点，我只好慢慢来。好在，”胡雪岩又说：“我跟她规规矩矩，干干净净，不会有什么太大的麻烦。”照这样一说，胡雪岩是决定不要阿珠了。这为什么？陈世龙深感诧异，“胡先生，有句话，我实在忍不住要问。”他眨着眼说：“张小姐哪一点不好？这样的人才，说句老实话，打了灯笼都找不着的。”由这两句话，可见他对阿珠十分倾倒。胡雪岩心想，自己这件事做好了，而且看来一定会有圆满结局，所以相当高兴。但表面上却不露声色，反而叹口气说：“唉！你不知道我的心。如果阿珠不是十分人才，我倒也马马虎虎安个家，不去多伤脑筋了。就因为阿珠是这样子打着灯笼都难找的人，我想想于心不忍。”“于心不忍？”似乎越说越玄妙了，陈世龙率直问道，“为什么？”
en: “Then what about Miss Zhang?” Chen asked after thinking, troubled on her behalf and feeling she was being unfairly treated. “Her whole heart is set on you.” “I know. That's why I have to take things slowly. Fortunately, as I said, we've behaved properly. Nothing has happened, so there shouldn't be any great difficulty.” This meant Hu had decided not to take A’zhu. But why? Chen was astonished. “Mr Hu, there's something I simply can't help asking.” He blinked. “What's wrong with Miss Zhang? To be honest, you could search with a lantern and not find another like her.” Those few words showed how much he admired her. Hu thought his good deed would succeed and was likely to end happily. He was pleased, but showed nothing. Instead he sighed. “Ah, you don't understand my feelings. If A’zhu weren't so exceptional, I might simply establish another household and give it no further thought. It's precisely because she's so rare that I can't bring myself to do it.” “Can't bring yourself?” It grew more mysterious with every word. Chen asked bluntly, “Why?”

zh: “第一，虽说‘两头大’，别人看来总是个小。太委屈阿珠。第二，我现在的情形，你看见的，各地方在跑，把她一个人冷冷清清摆在湖州，心里过意不去。”“胡先生！”陈世龙失声说道，“你倒真是好人。”“这也不见得。闲话少说，世龙，”胡雪岩低声说道：“我真正拿你当自己小兄弟一样，无话不谈。你人也聪明，我的心思你都明白。刚才我跟你谈的这番话，你千万不必给阿珠和他爹娘说。好在我的意思你也知道了，该当如何应付？你自己总有数！”陈世龙恍然大悟，喜不可言。原来这样子“推位让国”！怪不得口口声声说跟阿珠“规规矩矩，干干净净”，意思是表示并非把一件湿布衫脱了给别人穿。这番美意，着实可感。不过他既不愿明说，自己也不必多事去道谢。反正彼此心照就是了。
en: “First, however much we call it two wives of equal standing, others would still see her as a concubine. That would be unfair to her. Second, you see how I live, constantly moving from place to place. I couldn't bear to leave her lonely here in Huzhou.” “Mr Hu!” Chen exclaimed. “You really are a good man.” “Not necessarily. But enough of that. Shilong,” Hu lowered his voice, “I truly regard you as my own younger brother. There's nothing I wouldn't discuss with you. You're clever enough to understand my intentions. Don't repeat what I've just said to A’zhu or her parents. Now that you know what I mean, you should know how to act.” Chen understood at last and was overjoyed. So Hu was stepping aside for him! No wonder he kept stressing that nothing had happened between himself and A’zhu: he meant that he was not handing on some burden he had tired of carrying. This kindness deserved real gratitude. But since Hu preferred not to state it openly, Chen need not make a fuss of thanking him. They understood one another without words.

zh: 但有一点却必须弄清楚，“胡先生！”他问，“张小姐跟我谈起你，我该怎么说？”问到这话，就表示他已有所领会，胡雪岩答道：“你不妨有意无意多提这两点：第一，我太太很凶。第二，我忙，不会专守在一个地方。总而言之，言而总之一句话：你要让她慢慢把我忘记掉。”“好的。”陈世龙说，“我心里有数了。”因为有些默契，胡雪岩从当天起，就尽量找机会让陈世龙跟张家接近，凡有传话、办事、与老张有关的，都叫他奔走联络，同时明雪岩自己以“王大老爷有公事”这么一句话作为托辞，搬到知府衙门去住，整天不见人面。再下一天就是初十，一直到中午，仍旧不见胡雪岩露面，阿珠的娘烦躁了，“世龙，”她说，“你胡先生是怎么了？明天要动身了，凡事要有个交代，大家总要碰碰头才好。”“胡先生实在忙！”陈世龙说，“好在事情都交代清楚了。我们十三开船，有什么事，到杭州再问他也不迟。”话是不错，但照道理说，至少要替胡雪岩饯个行。这件事她前两夭就在筹划了，心里在想，动身之前这顿晚饭，总要在“家里”吃，所以一直也不曾提。现在看样子非先说好不可了。“世龙，我拜托你件事情，请你现在就替我劳步走一趟，跟你胡先生说，今天晚上无论如何要请好回来吃饭。”
en: One point still needed clarification. “Mr Hu, when Miss Zhang speaks to me about you, what should I say?” The question showed that Chen had understood. Hu answered, “You can casually bring up two things from time to time. First, my wife has a fierce temper. Second, I'm busy and won't stay in any one place. In a word, however you put it, you must gradually help her forget me.” “Very well. I know what to do.” With this unspoken understanding established, Hu began that very day to find every opportunity for Chen to be close to the Zhang family. Messages, errands, anything connected with Old Zhang—all went through Chen. Meanwhile Hu moved into the prefectural yamen, using Wang's official business as his excuse, and stayed out of sight all day. The following day was the tenth. By noon there was still no sign of him, and A’zhu's mother grew impatient. “Shilong, what's come over your Mr Hu? He's leaving tomorrow. Things need to be settled. Surely we should all meet before he goes.” “He really is busy. Fortunately, everything has been arranged. We sail on the thirteenth. If there's anything else, we can ask him in Hangzhou.” True enough, but surely they ought at least to give him a farewell dinner. She had been planning it for two days, assuming without saying so that he would eat his last evening meal at home. Now it seemed she must make an explicit arrangement. “Shilong, do me a favour. Please go at once and tell him he must come back to dinner tonight, whatever happens.”

zh: 陈世龙自然照办不误。可是这一去到下午四点钟才回张家，阿珠和她娘已经悬念不已，嘀嘀咕咕半天了。“怎么到这时候才回来？”阿珠大为埋怨。“我心里也急呀！”陈世龙平静地回答，“胡先生在王大老爷签押房里谈公事，叫我等一等；一等就等了个把时辰，我怕你们等得心急，想先回来说一声。刚刚抬起脚，胡先生出来了，话还说不到三句，王大老爷叫听差又来请。胡先生说马上就出来，叫我千万不要走，哪晓得又是半个时辰。”“这倒错怪你了！”阿珠歉意的笑笑。“胡先生说，来是一定要来的，就不知道啥时候？只怕顶早也要到七点。”“七点就七点。”阿珠的娘说，“十二点也要等。不过有两样菜，耽误了辰光，就不好吃了。”“那我到丝行里去了，还有好多事在那里。”“你晚上也要来吃饭。”阿珠的娘还有些不放心，“最好到衙门里等着你胡先生一起来。”陈世龙答应着刚刚走出门，只听阿珠在后面喊道：“等等！我跟你一起去。“
en: Chen naturally went, but did not return to the Zhang house until four in the afternoon. By then A’zhu and her mother had been worrying and speculating for a long time. “Why have you only just come back?” A’zhu demanded reproachfully. “I was anxious too,” he answered calmly. “Mr Hu was discussing official business in His Honour Wang's office and told me to wait. I waited a couple of hours. Afraid you would be worrying, I thought I'd come back first to let you know. Just as I was leaving, he came out. We'd scarcely exchanged three sentences when Wang sent an attendant to ask him back. Mr Hu said he'd be out immediately and told me not to leave. Who'd have thought it would take another hour?” “Then I blamed you unfairly.” A’zhu smiled apologetically. “He says he'll certainly come, but doesn't know when. Probably seven at the earliest.” “Seven it is,” her mother said. “We'd wait till midnight if necessary. Only there are two dishes that won't taste right if they're kept too long.” “I'll go to the silk firm, then. There's plenty to do.” “You must come to dinner too.” Still uneasy, she added, “Better go to the yamen and wait, then come back with him.” Chen agreed and had just stepped outside when A’zhu called after him, “Wait! I'll come with you.”

zh: 于是两个人同行从张家走向大经丝厅，陈世龙的朋友很多，一路走一路打招呼，有些人就打量阿珠，他总替人很郑重的介绍：“这位是张小姐！”这样介绍了两三次，阿珠又怪他了：“不要‘小姐、小姐’的，哪有个大小姐在街上乱跑的呢？”“那么叫你啥呢？”阿珠不响。“小姐”的称呼，在家里听听倒很过瘾，在人面前叫，就不大好意思了。但也不愿他叫自己的小名，其实也没有关系，不过这样叫惯了，将来改口很困难，而由“张小姐”改称“胡太太”或者“ 胡师母”，却是顺理成章的事。一想到将来的身分，她不由得有些脸上发热，怕陈世龙发觉，偷眼去觑他。不过他也在窥伺，视线相接，他倒不在乎，她却慌忙避了开去，脸更加红了。
en: They walked together from the Zhang house to Dajing. Chen had many friends and greeted people all along the way. Some looked curiously at A’zhu, and he invariably introduced her with great seriousness: “This is Miss Zhang.” After two or three such introductions, she complained again. “Stop calling me ‘Miss’ all the time. What young lady of a grand family goes wandering about the streets?” “Then what should I call you?” She did not answer. Being called Miss Zhang at home was quite gratifying, but hearing it before strangers embarrassed her. Yet she did not want him to use her childhood name either. There was really no harm in it, but once he became accustomed to that, changing later would be difficult. From Miss Zhang to Mrs Hu, or his mentor's wife, would be a natural progression. At the thought of her future position, her cheeks warmed. Afraid Chen might notice, she stole a glance at him. He too was watching. Their eyes met; he was untroubled, but she hastily looked away and blushed more deeply.

zh: 心里慌乱，天气又热，迎着西晒的太阳，额上沁出好些汗珠，偏偏走得匆忙，忘了带手绢。陈世龙只要她手一动，便知道她要什么，从袖子里取出自己的一方白杭纺手绢，悄悄塞了过去。看手绢雪白，仿佛还未用过，阿珠正在需要，便也不客气了。擦脸时，她闻到了一股陌生的气味。她一时有些出神，心里生出一种自己也说不清的情绪。她把手绢拿在手里，途中偶尔用来擦汗，一直走到大经门口才还给他。
en: Between her agitation and the heat of the westering sun, beads of sweat appeared on her forehead. In her hurried departure she had forgotten her handkerchief. A movement of her hand was enough for Chen to see what she needed. He quietly took a white Hangzhou-silk handkerchief from his sleeve and slipped it to her. It looked spotless, almost unused, and as she needed it she accepted without ceremony. As she wiped her face, she noticed an unfamiliar scent. For a moment she was lost in thoughts and feelings she could not quite explain. She kept the handkerchief in her hand, occasionally using it to wipe away the sweat, and returned it only when they reached Dajing's entrance.

adaptation.reason: 中性化以男子气味描写已知未成年人情欲反应的句子（8299–8303），保留借手绢、擦汗和归还的叙事情节。

zh: 大经丝行里堆满了打成包的“七里丝”，黄仪和老张正在点数算总帐。陈世龙和阿珠去得正好，堆在后面容房里的丝，就归他们帮忙。于是阵世龙点数，阿珠记帐，忙到天黑，还没有点完，阿珠提醒他说：“你该到衙门里去了！点不完的，晚上再来点。”看样子一时真个点不完了，陈世龙只得歇手，赶到知府衙门，接着胡雪岩一起到了张家。等胡雪岩刚刚宽衣坐定，捧着一杯茶在手，老张手持一张单子，来请他看帐：“确数虽还没有点完，约数已经有了，大概八百五十包左右，连水脚在内，每包成本，总要合成番洋二百八十块左右。”他说，“这票货色，已经二十万两银子的本钱下去了。”胡雪岩便问陈世龙：“八百五十包，每包二百八十块番洋，总数该多少？”“二十三万八。”陈世龙很快地回答。胡雪岩等了一下：“不错！”他又问老张：“可晓得这几天洋庄的行情，有没有涨落。”“没有什么变动。”“还是三百块左右。照这样算，每包可以赚二十，也不过一万七千五。”“这也不少了。一笔生意就赚番洋一万七千多！”
en: The silk firm was piled high with bales of Qili silk. Huang and Old Zhang were counting them and working out the total accounts. Chen and A’zhu arrived at just the right time to help with the silk stacked in the guest rooms at the rear. Chen counted, and A’zhu kept the record. They were still not finished at dusk when she reminded him, “You ought to go to the yamen. We can count the rest tonight.” Seeing that the work would indeed take longer, Chen stopped and hurried to the prefectural yamen, then accompanied Hu to the Zhang house. Hu had only just taken off his outer robe, sat down, and received a cup of tea when Old Zhang brought a sheet of figures. “We haven't finished the exact count, but we have an estimate: about eight hundred and fifty bales. Including freight, each bale will cost around two hundred and eighty foreign silver dollars. We've already put two hundred thousand taels into this shipment.” Hu asked Chen, “Eight hundred and fifty bales at two hundred and eighty dollars each—what does that come to?” “Two hundred and thirty-eight thousand,” Chen answered promptly. Hu paused. “Correct.” Then he asked Old Zhang, “Do you know whether prices paid by the foreign firms have changed these last few days?” “No real change.” “Still around three hundred dollars. That gives us twenty per bale, only seventeen thousand five hundred in all.” “That's a considerable sum! More than seventeen thousand foreign dollars on a single deal!”

zh: 老张老实，易于满足。胡雪岩觉得跟他无可深谈。想了想，只这样说道：“反正大经的佣金是您赚的。老张，不管怎么样，你是大经的老板，你那条船可以卖掉了。”老张莫名其妙，不知道他何以要说这话？陈世龙心里却明白，这是胡雪岩表示，将来就是不做亲戚，他仍旧要帮老张的忙。如果这是他的真心话，为人倒真是厚道了！“船也不必卖掉，你来来去去也方便些。”“这也好。”胡雪岩又说，“不过你自己不必再管船上的事了。应该把全副精神对付丝行。可惜，世龙帮不上你的忙！”“怎么呢？”老张有些着慌，“没有世龙帮忙，你再不在湖州，我一个人怕照顾不到。黄先生，说句实话，我吃不住他。”
en: Honest Old Zhang was easily satisfied. Hu felt that there was little point in discussing the matter deeply with him. After a moment's thought, he merely said, “Whatever happens, Dajing's commission is yours to earn. Old Zhang, you're the proprietor of Dajing in any case. You can sell that boat of yours.” Old Zhang was bewildered. Why say that? Chen, however, understood: Hu was making clear that, even if they did not become relatives, he would continue to help Old Zhang. If sincere, that was truly generous. “There's no need to sell the boat,” Old Zhang answered. “It makes your journeys easier.” “Very well. But you needn't concern yourself with the boat any longer. Put all your energy into the silk firm. It's a pity Shilong can't help you.” “Why not?” Old Zhang grew alarmed. “Without him, and with you away from Huzhou, I'm afraid I can't manage alone. To tell the truth, I can't keep Mr Huang in hand.”

zh: 老张慌张，胡雪岩却泰然得很，这些事在他根本不算难题，同时他此刻又有了新的念头，要略为想一想，所以微笑着不作答复。老实的老张，只当他不以为然，黄仪有些霸道的地方，是他亲身所体验到的，但说出来是在背后讲人坏话，他觉得道义有亏，不说，看胡雪岩的样子不相信。那怎么办呢？只有找个证人出来。“黄先生为人如何？世龙也知道的。”他眼望着陈世龙说：“请你说给胡先生听听。”“不必！”胡雪岩摇着手说：“我看也看得出来。说句实话，这趟我到湖州来，事事圆满。就是这位仁兄，我还没有把他收服。你当然吃不住他，不过有人吃得住他，你请放心好了，反正眼前也没有什么事了，等你从上海回来再说。”“那时候怎么样？”“那时候……”他看了看陈世龙说，“我自有极妥当的办法，包你称心如意。”
en: Old Zhang was anxious, but Hu remained perfectly calm. Such matters were no difficulty to him. Besides, a new idea had occurred to him and needed a little thought, so he merely smiled without answering. Honest Old Zhang took this for disbelief. He had personally experienced Huang's domineering ways, but to describe them behind the man's back seemed disloyal. Yet silence would leave Hu unconvinced. What could he do? Find a witness. “Shilong knows what Mr Huang is like.” Looking at Chen, he said, “Please explain to Mr Hu.” “No need!” Hu waved this aside. “I can see for myself. To be honest, everything on this visit to Huzhou has gone well except this gentleman: I haven't yet brought him into line. Naturally, you can't control him, but someone can. Don't worry. For the moment there's nothing urgent. We'll discuss it when you return from Shanghai.” “What will happen then?” “Then...” Hu glanced at Chen. “I'll have an excellent arrangement, one that will satisfy you completely.”

zh: 他们在谈话，阿珠一面摆碗筷，一面留心在听。她心里在想，最妥当的办法，就是不用黄仪，让陈世龙来帮忙。但是，她也听说过，胡雪岩预备让陈世龙学洋文，将来在上海“坐庄”，专管跟外国人打交道。这也是一项要紧的职司，胡雪岩未见得肯如此安排。那么除些以外，还有什么妥当的安排？她的这个想法，恰好与胡雪岩相同，但他只字不提，因为时机未到。这时候，大家一起团团坐下吃饭，胡雪岩上坐，左首老张，右首陈世龙。下方是她们母女俩的位子。阿珠的娘还在厨房里，阿珠一坐坐在右首，恰好靠近陈世龙。“来端菜！”因为爱珍临时被遣上街买东西去了，所以阿珠的娘，高声在厨房里喊。听这一喊，却是陈世龙先起身，阿珠便很自然地把他一位：“你坐在那里，我去。”陈世龙还是跟着去了，两个人同出同进，也不知道他在路上说了什么？阿珠只是在笑。胡雪岩一面跟老张喝酒，一面眼角瞟过来，心里有些好笑。
en: While they talked, A’zhu laid out bowls and chopsticks and listened carefully. She thought the best arrangement would be to dispense with Huang and have Chen help instead. But she had also heard that Hu intended Chen to learn a foreign language and eventually represent the firm in Shanghai, dealing exclusively with foreigners. That was an important position too, and Hu might not be willing to change his plans. What other satisfactory arrangement could there be? Her idea happened to be exactly the same as Hu's, but he said nothing because the time was not yet ripe. They now sat down together to eat. Hu occupied the place of honour, Old Zhang sat to his left, and Chen to his right. The seats at the lower end were for A’zhu and her mother. Her mother was still in the kitchen, and A’zhu took the right-hand seat, next to Chen. “Come and fetch the dishes!” her mother called from the kitchen, Aizhen having been sent out on an errand. Chen was the first to rise. Quite naturally, A’zhu caught his arm. “Stay where you are. I'll go.” He followed her nevertheless. They went back and forth together, and whatever he said along the way kept making her laugh. Drinking with Old Zhang, Hu watched them out of the corner of his eye and was quietly amused.

zh: 吃完饭，略坐一坐，胡雪岩又要走了，说还有事要跟郁四商量。阿珠和她娘听这一说，怏怏之意，现于颜色，她们都似乎有许多话要跟他谈，但细想一想，却又没有一句话是紧要而非在此刻说不可的，便只好放他走了。“杭州见面了。”胡雪岩就这么一句话告别。等走到门口，阿珠的娘赶上来喊住他问：“那么，啥时候再到湖州来？”“现在哪里说得定？”阿珠的娘回身看了一下，阿珠不在旁边，便又说道：“那件事，您放在心上。今年要办了它。”“对，对！”胡雪岩答道：“今年年里，一定热热闹闹办喜事。那时我一定要来。“如果是做新郎官，当然一定要来，何消说得？阿珠的娘觉得他的话奇怪，却做梦也没有想到，胡雪岩已经不是她的“女婿”了。
en: After dinner and a short rest, Hu rose to leave again, saying he still had something to discuss with Yu. Disappointment showed on the faces of both women. They seemed to have a great deal to say to him, yet on reflection neither could find a single matter so urgent that it must be raised now. They could only let him go. “We'll meet in Hangzhou,” was his entire farewell. At the door, A’zhu's mother caught up and called him back. “When will you come to Huzhou again?” “How can I say just now?” She glanced behind her. A’zhu was not nearby. “Keep that matter in mind. It must be settled this year.” “Yes, yes,” Hu replied. “Before this year is out, there will certainly be a splendid wedding. I'll definitely come for it.” If he was to be the groom, of course he must come. Why say so? His words struck her as odd, but never in her dreams did she imagine that Hu was no longer her prospective son-in-law.
